Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  01 = 0 * 1
  02 = 0 * 2
  10 = 1 * 0
  11 = 1 * 1
  20 = 2 * 0
  21 = 2 * 1
  012 = 01 * 2
  212 = 21 * 2
  0001 = 00 * 01
  0201 = 02 * 01
  0220 = 02 * 20
  1110 = 11 * 10
  1120 = 11 * 20
  2102 = 21 * 02
  2212 = 2 * 212
  0122212 = 012 * 2212
  00011110 = 0001 * 1110
  02202102 = 0220 * 2102
  11200201 = 1120 * 0201
